title: Gradient Descent: Stepping Down x Squared

input.request: explain gradient descent with one worked example

description:
Understand that gradient descent finds a minimum by repeatedly stepping opposite the slope, and see two steps worked out on f(x) = x squared.
Scene 1 (12 s): Gradient descent finds a function's lowest point by repeatedly stepping opposite the slope, which means downhill.
Scene 2 (18 s): Each step uses new x = x minus step size times slope, and the steps shrink as the slope flattens near the minimum.
Narrated by one voice; 2 scenes; 30 seconds.
